profile.headline: Web Developer | Chemical Engineer | CU Boulder
profile.summary: I am a graduate from the University of Colorado and certified Full Stack Web Developer from BrainStation with experience developing React apps in a team setting. I am currently looking for a position that allows me to apply and grow my engineering skills.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Actively seeks out hundreds of customers to assess their needs and provide assistance. Applied training and tools to provide customer detailed information and recommendations to sell product and services. Worked with coworkers on projects to create seasonal displays and adapt to changes in inventory.

positions.title: Warehouse Associate
positions.description: A part-time dedicated team member that retrieved items, packaged, and verified orders for customers and essential businesses relying on Amazon services. Applied training techniques to optimize output of packages

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description: Provided customer checkout services that is quick, professional, and friendly.   Used handheld devices (e.g., mobile phone, LRT gun, tablet, iPad) to enter, access, and output information.

projects.title: Capstone Project
projects.description: Created a full-stack CRUD mobile application that allows users to manage their monthly subscriptions and track spending habits. The application uses React and SASS for the front-end with support from Node, Express, MySQL and Knex.js on the back end.

projects.title: Industry Project
projects.description: Worked on a 6-person multi-disciplinary team consisting of web developers and UX/UI designers to create an innovative solution for wearable tech company, WHOOP. GitHub, Jira, and Slack were used for team collaboration. The application uses React and SASS for the front-end with support from Node and Express on the back end.
